notes: Scene camera set or not; COLS_CAM1 lookup found or not (then entry ESI is 0, since the original uses its caller's ESI as the record), view data found or not; camera indexes 0..3 over random camera records; shake counts 0, 1, 2, 5 and negative. 0x97ca8 and 0xd0b68 run as original code; the three rotations log EAX and DX, the lookups log their contract and return queued values, 0x9357c logs the update mode and the message hook logs its format.
